data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.px68k_cpuspeed.Help
data.value: Sets the frequency of the emulated CPU.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.px68k_ramsize.Help
data.value: Sets the amount of main memory in the emulated computer.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.px68k_adpcm_vol.Help
data.value: Sets the volume of the ADPCM sound channel.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.px68k_opm_vol.Help
data.value: Sets the volume of the FM sound channels.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.px68k_vbtn_swap.Help
data.value: Changes the order of the two primary fire buttons.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.px68k_no_wait_mode.Help
data.value: Runs without waiting for the normal emulation speed.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.px68k_frameskip.Help
data.value: Sets how frequently the emulator renders a video frame.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.px68k_push_video_before_audio.Help
data.value: Sends each video frame before its audio samples.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.px68k_adjust_frame_rates.Help
data.value: Adjusts the emulated frame timing for the display refresh rate.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.px68k_audio_desync_hack.Help
data.value: Adjusts audio timing when sound and video lose synchronization.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.px68k_text_off.Help
data.value: Disables rendering of the text layer.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.px68k_grp_off.Help
data.value: Disables rendering of the graphics layer.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.px68k_sp_off.Help
data.value: Disables rendering of sprites and the background layer.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.X1_RESOLUTE.Help
data.value: Selects the low or high resolution output of the emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.X1_FPS.Help
data.value: Selects how many video frames the emulator renders per second.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.X1_DISPSYNC.Help
data.value: Synchronizes rendering with the emulated display.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.X1_RASTER.Help
data.value: Enables rendering of effects produced during the screen scan.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.X1_NOWAIT.Help
data.value: Runs without waiting for the normal emulation speed.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.X1_BTN_MODE.Help
data.value: Changes the order of the primary fire buttons.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.X1_BTN_RAPID.Help
data.value: Enables repeated firing while a fire button is held.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.X1_AUDIO_RATE.Help
data.value: Selects the sampling rate of the sound produced by the emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.X1_SEEKSND.Help
data.value: Plays a sound when the disk drive moves its head.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.X1_FMBOARD.Help
data.value: Enables the optional FM sound board.

data.name: Emulation.Sharp.Option.X1_CPU_CLOCK.Help
data.value: Sets the frequency of the emulated CPU.
